subject: Request: Detailed invoice token breakdown & commit discount options
messages:
From: Sara Kim <sara.kim@stellarnow.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@stellarnow.ai>
Date: 2026-02-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Line item breakdown & commit options

Hi Jordan / Alex,

We're doing a finance review ahead of our upcoming renewal evaluation and I need a little more granularity from the last two invoices. Specifically:

- Can you provide an itemized line-by-line map that shows how each invoice line corresponds to token consumption (prompt vs completion vs system tokens)?
- We want a CSV export of raw usage (timestamped requests, token counts, model used, route) for Feb so our finance team can do a reconciliation.
- What commit tiers and per-token discounts does Redwood offer for hosted API usage? We're looking at whether a 12 month commit makes sense versus keeping usage-based.

Also: we saw a spike on Feb 2 that doubled our token spend; need visibility on which routes generated that.

Can you send the CSV and a short summary of commit pricing? If possible, include an example invoice line mapping we can share with accounting. If not, lets book 30 minutes this week.

Thanks,
Sara Kim
Head of Platform Ops
StellarNow

Attachments: (none)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sara Kim <sara.kim@stellarnow.ai>, Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@stellarnow.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-18T10:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Line item breakdown & commit options

Hi Sara — thanks for the note. I pulled together the export and a short pricing summary; attaching both. High level answers first, then the files: 

- Usage export: attached CSV (usage_export_2026-02.csv) includes per-request rows with columns: timestamp, model, route, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, cost_usd, request_id. That should let finance reconcile to invoice lines.
- Invoice mapping: on our invoices youll typically see lines surfaced as: "Generation - model-name" (covers prompt+completion tokens), "Embeddings - model-name" (per-embedding unit), and occasional "Storage/Retention" lines if applied. I attached a short sample mapping in the PDF.
- Commit tiers (hosted API, per-token): proposal (net of platform fees):
  * 0 - 1M tokens / mo: list price, no volume discount
  * 1M - 5M tokens / mo: 7% off per-token rate
  * 5M - 20M tokens / mo: 12% off per-token rate
  * >20M tokens / mo: custom negotiated (usually includes SLA and invoicing cadence)

We also offer blending by route (e.g., generation vs embeddings) and can structure a commit that sets separate thresholds if you want tighter cost controls. For spikes, we can add an automated alert in the Console and set a soft cap notification before a hard cap.

Attached: usage_export_2026-02.csv (sample rows), redwood_commit_options_Q1-2026.pdf (commit tier examples + sample invoice mapping).

Available for a quick call today at 3pm PT or tomorrow morning. If either works, Ill send a calendar invite.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132

Attachments: usage_export_2026-02.csv (CSV stub), redwood_commit_options_Q1-2026.pdf (PDF stub)
From: Sara Kim <sara.kim@stellarnow.ai>

Date: 2026-02-19T08:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Line item breakdown & commit options

Thanks Jordan — got the files and PDF. A couple quick clarifying questions before we loop finance:

- On the CSV, how should we attribute token columns to invoice lines? If a single request shows prompt_tokens=120 and completion_tokens=860, does that map to one invoice line (Generation - model-name) with total_tokens=980? Or do you split prompt and completion into separate lines on the invoice?
- For streaming responses where completion tokens are produced over time, are those captured in total_tokens the same way?
- What's the cadence for the exported file? Is daily available or just monthly aggregates?

If you can answer in a quick thread reply thatd be great. If not, we can take the call.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Sara
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sara Kim <sara.kim@stellarnow.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-20T16:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Line item breakdown & commit options

Hi Sara — great questions. Short answers here, with exactly how the CSV maps to invoice lines so finance can reconcile programmatically: 

1) Invoice mapping rules
  - Generation lines: we collapse prompt + completion into a single invoice line per model/route per billing period. So your example (prompt=120, completion=860) would reconcile to one "Generation - gpt-redwood-1" line with total_tokens=980. The CSVs prompt_tokens/completion_tokens fields let you audit the split, but invoice line show the aggregated total to keep bills concise.
  - Embeddings lines: invoiced as separate lines measured in embedding units (CSV column: embedding_units).
  - System tokens / safety tokens: included in the Generation total_tokens; we can surface them separately on a custom reporting export if you need per-token-category lines.

2) Streaming
  - Streaming completions are accounted for the same way (tokens consumed are summed on the request or across request fragments and appear in total_tokens). The CSV includes request_id and fragment_id (when applicable) so you can group fragments into a single user request.

3) Export cadence and reconciliation
  - By default we provide a monthly export, but the Console supports daily exports and an API endpoint for arbitrary date ranges. We can drop a daily CSV to your S3 or share via secure Drive.

4) Spike investigation
  - The spike on 2026-02-02: preliminary note — it looks like a burst from the "/chat/interactive" route due to a training job hitting prod. We can include a per-route cost breakdown column in the export (route_cost_usd) so you can quickly see which routes caused the charge. Dev (ccd) can create a filtered export for Feb 1-3 if you want the raw rows.

Next steps (recommended):
  A) Ill have Dev generate a Feb 1-3 filtered CSV and upload to the HubSpot record (link above).
  B) If you want to pursue a commit: we can propose a 12-month commit with monthly true-ups and an amortized invoice schedule. Example: commit to 6M tokens/month at 12% off, monthly settlement with true-up at quarter end. Ive attached the PDF with common commit templates.
  C) If finance needs a mapping doc, Monica can provide a short two-page reconciliation template (Ill ask her to add it inline here).

Let me know which items you want prioritized and Ill get them moving. Happy to jump on a 30-minute call to walk the export if you prefer.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

---
Monica Patel (on behalf)
Senior Manager, Sales Operations — I can draft the two-page reconciliation template Jordan mentioned and include a sample amortization schedule for a 12-month commit. Will follow-up once Dev confirms the Feb export is ready.
